_readme: TEMPLATE. Every null must be filled from PRIMARY sources (HDB, CPF Board, IRAS, MAS) and cited. Do not put unverified numbers here. Bump 'version' and set 'effectiveDate' whenever a rule changes. Rules moved in Aug 2024, Oct 2024, Aug 2025 and Aug 2026.

cpf._partialMonthTreatmentNote: Team assumption (DECISIONS.md D12): EXCLUDE_BOTH, pending CPF Board confirmation. Alternative considered: INCLUDE_BOTH, based on CPF's general interest rule (withdrawals stop earning from the month they occur; refunds earn from the next month).
cpf._compoundingNote: Computed monthly at the OA rate, compounded yearly (CPF Board)

loans._hdbRatePremiumNote: HDB concessionary rate is pegged at 0.1% above the CPF OA rate (CPF Board, 22 Sep 2026 release)

classifications._note: subsidyRecoveryRate also varies per BTO project: store the per-project value on the project record and use these as class defaults only.
classifications._subsidyRecoveryNote: subsidyRecoveryRate also varies per BTO project: store the per-project value on the project record and use these as class defaults only.
